tweet_summary: Small account 'B maps' (2.8k followers) replies to a Daily Mail story about Ernie Dosio (75) being trampled by elephants while hunting in Gabon: 'Elephants have a very sharp memory. They probably remembered him for killing their family members.' Attached image is a Google AI-Overview snippet about elephant memory. 34.9k impressions.
why_note_decision: Two pieces: (1) Elephants DO have well-documented exceptional long-term memory (Cleveland Zoological — the source in the screenshot itself — and broad scientific consensus); the AI Overview content is accurate. (2) The 'they remembered him' framing is explicit speculation by the user ('They probably remembered him...'), not a factual claim. Per Daily Mail/NY Post/LBC/Futurism/Fox News reporting on the Dosio incident, the elephants charged because the hunting party surprised them — they were forest elephant cows protecting a calf. There's no evidence of memory-based revenge. But this is OPINION/speculation in the original tweet, expressly hedged with 'probably' — not a falsifiable factual claim. The original note 'corrects' speculative musing on a news event, which is the classic noteNotNeeded false-positive pattern.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The tweet is explicitly speculative ('They probably remembered him for killing their family members') — opinion, not a factual claim. The underlying incident (Ernie Dosio trampled in Gabon while hunting antelope; elephants charged after his party surprised them) is well-reported. Any note 'correcting' the elephant-revenge speculation is a false positive on user opinion. FAIL any note that addresses the memory-revenge musing as a factual claim.

original_unhelpful_note.text: There is no evidence the elephants recognized or remembered the hunter from prior kills; the herd charged after he and his guide surprised them in dense forest during an antelope hunt. https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-15761595/Millionaire-US-big-game-hunter-75-trampled-death-five-elephants-hunting-antelope-central-Africa.html https://nypost.com/2026/04/24/world-news/millionaire-big-game-hunter-75-trampled-to-death-by-five-elephants-while-eyeing-his-next-kill-in-africa
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: noteNotNeeded — substance is accurate (no memory-revenge evidence; charge was a surprise encounter with calf), but the original tweet expressly hedges with 'probably' and is overt opinion. Correcting speculation = false positive.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Tweet is overt speculation; underlying incident (Dosio trampled in Gabon hunting antelope, surprise-encounter with cow elephants + calf) is real.
fact_check.notes: Elephants DO have well-documented long-term memory (Cleveland Zoological, broad consensus). 'Revenge for prior kills' is speculation — no evidence either way. Tweet is opinion.

importance.lens_rationale: Low-stakes; tests the bot's no-note instinct on overt user speculation ('they probably...') replying to a news event.
